$comment: Sports grounds (tools/content/kit/grounds.mjs; St. John's step 4b: docs/map-briefs/st_johns, the volleyball court at Scott Johnston / Hazelwood's west end): a net on two posts and a sand court with its lines. Our own shapes and colours.

notes.1: First version (St. John's step 4b): a volleyball net 9.5 m wide and 1 m deep, its top at 2.43 m, between two steel posts 2.55 m tall on foot plates, 10.6 m over all; white tapes, a dark cord grid, guy cords to the posts. Collides as its posts and the net's band (1.43 to 2.43 m), a lattice to sight as the chain-link fence is: bots see through it, rounds pass (fabric). Place it across the Sand Court's middle, turned as the court is.

First version (St. John's step 4b): a sand bed 15 × 24 m and 4 cm deep with a bevelled edge, the lines of a volleyball court 9 × 18 m round its middle and a centre line across (under the net). No collision: walked on as the ground under it, so lay it on flat ground (MapMaker's Terrain flatten, or a level spot).

First version (St. John's step 10): a basketball court's lines painted on a floor, 26 x 14 m: outline, centre line and circle, the keys filled in a colour, free-throw circles, three-point lines. Lies a hair over the floor (an Oak Planks floor reads as maple). Collides as nothing.

First version (St. John's step 10): a basketball hoop on a steel bracket from a wall (its back on -z): a white backboard 1.2 m out with its target square, an orange rim at 3.05 m with a cord net. Collides as nothing (above everyone's head).

First version (St. John's step 10, Gerber Pool): a pool's four lanes, 22 x 10 m: three lane ropes floating at the prop's top (the water's surface) in bands of red, white and blue, red near the walls; dark lane stripes with a T on the floor; a target on each end wall. Its foot on the pool's floor. Collides as nothing (the water and the basin do).
